product.title: Sunset and Night Photography Tour on Trail Ridge Road

description.text: Take the chance to capture the beauty of the Rocky Mountains at sunset during this after-dark photography tour along Trail Ridge Road. Along with your guide, discover different locations for golden hour and sunset shots in the national park. Stops include Trail Ridge Road. Your guide will offer tips on composition and camera settings. Ideal for travelers basing in Estes Park or the Front Range who want a guided Rocky Mountain National Park outing without self-driving mountain roads.
